cards.example_en: Dew on the grass soaked my shoes before sunrise.
cards.example_zh: 日出前，草上的露水打湿了我的鞋。

cards.example_en: A great chance came when the coach needed another singer.
cards.example_zh: 教练还需要一名歌手时，一个极好的机会来了。

cards.example_en: Green apples from our garden taste sharper than the red ones.
cards.example_zh: 我们花园里的青苹果比红苹果味道更酸。

cards.example_en: We greet the teacher at the door.
cards.example_zh: 我们在门口问候老师。

cards.example_en: Grey clouds piled up, so we carried the washing inside.
cards.example_zh: 灰云堆了起来，于是我们把洗好的衣服收了进去。

cards.example_en: Apples lay on the ground under the tree after the strong wind.
cards.example_zh: 大风过后，苹果落在了树下的地面上。

cards.example_en: Our project group met in the library after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们的项目组午饭后在图书馆碰面。

cards.example_en: Tomatoes grow well in our sunny backyard.
cards.example_zh: 西红柿在我们家向阳的后院长得很好。

cards.example_en: A guard checked tickets at the entrance.
cards.example_zh: 守卫在入口查票。

cards.example_en: Guess the price of that cake in the bakery window.
cards.example_zh: 猜一猜面包店橱窗里那块蛋糕的价钱。

cards.example_en: We have a guest from another school today.
cards.example_zh: 今天我们有一位来自其他学校的客人。

cards.example_en: Our guide showed us around the castle.
cards.example_zh: 我们的导游带我们参观了城堡。

cards.example_en: Leo practised the guitar in his room until bedtime.
cards.example_zh: 利奥在自己房间里练吉他，一直练到睡觉。

cards.example_en: His toy gun snapped when it hit the stone floor.
cards.example_zh: 他的玩具枪砸到石地板上，断了。

cards.example_en: The match will be held in the school gym.
cards.example_zh: 比赛在学校体育馆举行。

cards.example_en: Leaving shoes by the door became a habit in our flat.
cards.example_zh: 把鞋放在门口成了我们家的习惯。

cards.example_en: Wind tangled her hair on the walk to the station.
cards.example_zh: 走到车站的路上，风吹乱了她的头发。

cards.example_en: Half of the sandwiches were eaten before the picnic started.
cards.example_zh: 野餐还没开始，三明治就被吃掉了一半。

cards.example_en: Speeches and songs filled the hall on prize day.
cards.example_zh: 颁奖那天，大厅里满是演讲和歌声。

cards.example_en: He ordered a hamburger and some milk.
cards.example_zh: 他点了一个汉堡和一些牛奶。

cards.example_en: Paint covered his hand after the art lesson ended.
cards.example_zh: 美术课结束后，他满手都是颜料。

cards.example_en: The handsome actor played a young teacher.
cards.example_zh: 那位英俊的演员扮演一位年轻老师。

cards.example_en: Hang your wet coat on the hook by the door.
cards.example_zh: 把湿外套挂在门边的钩子上。

cards.example_en: Accidents often happen when people run on wet stairs.
cards.example_zh: 人们在湿楼梯上奔跑时，常常会发生事故。

cards.example_en: Happy shouts came from the playground as soon as the bell rang.
cards.example_zh: 铃声一响，操场上就传来开心的喊声。

cards.example_en: The hard ground made our feet ache during the morning drill.
cards.example_zh: 坚硬的地面让我们在早操时脚发疼。

cards.example_en: I hardly know him.
cards.example_zh: 我几乎不认识他。

cards.example_en: The storm did little harm to the school.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨对学校几乎没造成损害。

cards.example_en: My hat landed in a puddle when the wind rose.
cards.example_zh: 风大起来时，我的帽子掉进了水坑。

cards.example_en: I hate getting up early on cold winter mornings.
cards.example_zh: 我讨厌在寒冷的冬天早起。

cards.example_en: Do you have a pencil I can borrow?
cards.example_zh: 你有铅笔可以借我吗？

cards.example_en: He plays basketball after school.
cards.example_zh: 他放学后打篮球。

cards.example_en: She bumped her head on the low bunk at camp.
cards.example_zh: 她在营地的矮床上碰了头。

cards.example_en: Daily walks improved his health after the long illness.
cards.example_zh: 久病之后，每天散步让他的健康好了起来。

cards.example_en: My little brother stays healthy by playing football after school.
cards.example_zh: 我弟弟放学后踢足球，身体一直很健康。

cards.example_en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
cards.example_zh: 我能听见鸟儿在我卧室的窗外唱歌。

cards.example_en: Her heart raced as she waited for the exam results.
cards.example_zh: 她等考试成绩时，心脏跳得飞快。

cards.example_en: Afternoon heat drove us into the shaded courtyard.
cards.example_zh: 午后的热把我们赶进了阴凉的院子。

cards.example_en: The heavy suitcase was hard to lift onto the bus.
cards.example_zh: 那个很重的行李箱很难抬上公交车。

cards.example_en: Extra height helped her block shots in basketball.
cards.example_zh: 身高优势帮她在篮球赛里封盖投篮。

cards.example_en: Hello! My name is Amy.
cards.example_zh: 你好！我叫 Amy。

cards.example_en: Older classmates help younger ones with difficult homework.
cards.example_zh: 高年级同学在较难的作业上帮助低年级同学。

cards.example_en: Our neighbour was helpful when Mum hurt her ankle.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈扭伤脚踝时，邻居帮了大忙。

cards.example_en: The hen sat quietly on her eggs.
cards.example_zh: 母鸡安静地卧在蛋上。

cards.example_en: This is her new school bag.
cards.example_zh: 这是她的新书包。

cards.example_en: Please sit here next to me.
cards.example_zh: 请坐在我旁边这里。

cards.example_en: Neighbours called her a hero after she stopped the fire.
cards.example_zh: 她把火扑灭之后，邻居们称她为英雄。

cards.example_en: That blue bike is hers.
cards.example_zh: 那辆蓝色自行车是她的。

cards.example_en: She made the cake herself.
cards.example_zh: 蛋糕是她自己做的。

cards.example_en: Hi! Are you in this class?
cards.example_zh: 嗨！你是这个班的吗？

word.example_en: A good many birds rest by the lake.
I want to be a nurse when I grow up.
Grandma made the scarf by hand.
word.example_zh: 奶奶用手工织了这条围巾。

word.example_en: We have enough water on hand.
Can you give me a hand with this box?
word.example_zh: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？

word.example_en: I have to finish this page tonight.
word.example_zh: 我今晚必须完成这一页。

word.example_en: Have fun at the music club.
This puzzle is fun. Have a try.
word.example_zh: 这个谜题很好玩，试一试。

word.example_en: I have a cold, so I will rest today.
word.example_zh: 我得了感冒，所以今天休息。

word.example_en: May I have a look at your photo?
word.example_zh: 我可以看一看你的照片吗？

word.example_en: She runs in order to keep fit.
word.example_zh: 她跑步是为了保持健康。

word.example_en: Did you hear of that new film?
word.example_zh: 你听说过那部新电影吗？

word.example_en: I hope to hear from my pen friend.
word.example_zh: 我希望收到笔友的来信。

word.example_en: She will put her heart into every drawing.
word.example_zh: 她会全心投入每一幅画。

word.example_en: Can you help me with the heavy bag?
word.example_zh: 你能帮我拿这个重包吗？

word.example_en: There are flowers here and there in the yard.
